additional_info.subject: RE: ID0399135-DC/Si-D/CL-[Multi] Fireware update CRM:01811000569
additional_info.body:
Hello Jesus,
Greetings
Please find the answer to your question below in green
The version V2.10, can we pass directly to V4.011, or first V2.11. -
Correct way to update is from v2.x.x to v3.x.x to v4.x.x to v5.x.x to v6.x.x. It is not required to update it to v2.11 from v2.10
We have dispensers, where cable control has hardwiring. Do you recommend associate dispenser before update?,or later, after upgrade -
You can do it either way, it will not affect the operation
Any another update, for example Logo PLC?. -
LOGO needs to be updated to v2.7.0 (
SI E Q-Feedback Q2308 Sicharge D - LOGO! Update to Ensure Auto-Reboot After Overh... - ID: 109820985 - Industry Support Siemens
)
For first testing, can we limit the charger up to minimum, for example 10-20kW?. The site, not possible by now over 20kW, we are expecting local permission.-
You can limit to 20KW from SCB (PLC Configuration)
The new version, V6, do you recommend?, with NEXE OCPP we have tested the charger 170002133 in show room up to 4.011, very well. Exist any risk in OCPP interoperability if we pass to V6? -
We would recommend to update to v4.0.11 once everything is stable then update to v6.0.3 through OTA as v6.0.3 contains FW update for router as well.
Let us know if you have any other questions or can we close this ticket?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
